Your identity name should be easy to recognize. Your recovery path should be exact.

Nostr WoT 0.7.0 adds optional names and custom derivation paths when creating a seed-derived identity. The path sits under Advanced, with an npub and hex preview before you save. Leave the automatic choice alone if you do not need a custom one.

A local name helps distinguish work, project and testing accounts. It does not change your public key or publish a profile name. A different derivation path normally produces a different identity.

That flexibility comes with a practical requirement: keep the exact path with your seed backup. Another client may number accounts differently.

The guide covers creation, previews and recovery in seven languages. Version 0.7.0 is downloadable from GitHub; browser-store approval is not confirmed here.

nostr:
A name for the account list. An exact path for recovery.

Nostr WoT 0.7.0 lets you name a new seed-derived identity and choose its derivation path under Advanced. Preview the npub and hex before saving, or keep the automatic path.

The name is local. The path affects the key. Save the exact path with your seed backup, and remember that identities sharing a seed also share that seed’s security.

The guide is available in seven languages. GitHub download availability is verified; browser-store approval is not confirmed.
